```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The HIV/AIDS pandemic is a massive human tragedy.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The HIV/AIDS pandemic is a security risk of the highest order that threatens to plunge nations into chaos.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There are an estimated 33 million people across the planet infected with HIV/AIDS, including more than one million people in the U.S.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Nearly 8,000 people die every day of AIDS.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to provide $50 billion over five years to strengthen existing U.S. programs and expand them to new regions of the world, including Southeast Asia, India, and parts of Europe, where the HIV/AIDS burden is growing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to increase U.S. contributions to the Global Fund to ensure that global efforts to fight endemic disease continue to move ahead.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the adoption of humanitarian licensing policies that ensure medications developed with the U.S. taxpayer dollars are available off patent in developing countries.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to repeal the global gag rule and reinstate funding to the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to expand access to health care and nutrition for women and reduce the burden of maternal mortality.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Malaria, tuberculosis, and neglected tropical diseases require more effort to fight.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
